bindings.caption: Dissolve 4-Bs/Oct Si QDs, 1,4-diethynylbenzene, Pd(PPh3)2Cl2, and CuI . Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add triethylamine to the reaction mixture. Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Stir the reaction mixture at 110 °C for 2 h. temperature: 110 °C. duration: 2 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add methanol to precipitate the Si QD cluster. Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Centrifuge the Si QD cluster at 12000 rpm for 10 min. duration: 10 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Wash the Si QD cluster with methanol. Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Dry the Si QD cluster using a rotary evaporator. Recipe-level reported vessel: 100 mL two-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
